description: Batch-local unit-region GHM-C for binary logits, weighting each binary cross-entropy term by inverse estimated gradient density; Chen et al., §Problem Description Eqs. (1)-(3) and §Unit Region Approximation Eqs. (9)-(11), paper.txt:97-124, 215-251; implementation: src/topologies/implementations/losses/ghm.py:8-58.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    features = torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    targets = (features[:2] > 1.0).float()
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(features), "targets": synth.Tensor(targets)}
ds = synth.Spec("ghm-multilabel", generator=samples, size=16, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("regression", split="train", input_field="inputs", target_field="targets", preserve_shape=True)
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=2)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="regression", recipe_config={"loss": "ghm", "loss_kwargs": {"bins": 30}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train a multilabel model with GHM-C

name: Gradient Harmonizing Mechanism classification loss (GHM-C)

parameters.additional parameters: unsupported; unrecognized keyword parameters raise ValueError
parameters.bins: positive integer number of equal-width gradient-norm bins (default 30)
parameters.ignore_index: optional target value excluded from density counts and reductions; ignored positions return zero with reduction='none'
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point raw binary logits of any nonempty shape
parameters.reduction: none returns per-element weighted losses, mean divides their sum by valid element count, or sum totals them (default mean)
parameters.targets: real tensor with the same shape and device as logits; valid values must be binary 0 or 1
